protocol.gold_validation: reuse existing local evidence, per user; no new qualification matrix
runtime_adaptations: effort/max tokens via OpenHands LLM settings
per-task Docker image names and serialized startup
protocol.input_isolation: one trial per repair container; no evaluator, Gold, other trials or Docker socket mounted

usage.note: Native repair token totals and recorded execution cost estimates; actual charges and repair cost are unknown. Framework input/output token fields may be zero despite positive total_tokens. Token totals cover recorded native usage; in-flight requests without returned usage may be unaccounted. Execution provider request counts are unknown.

limitations: Full task score is reported separately from unadjudicated semantic target repair and preservation.
single-video-silence-remover-RI-003 has byte-identical candidates in rounds 1-4: the first candidate passed on its fourth execution.
No-skill-tool rounds do not establish Skill body use; exact positive body evidence is recorded per round.
Existing Gold qualification is reused; no fresh qualification or baseline calls were added.
